how.title: How I work
how.lead: Five phases shared by every way of working: what you see in each and what I need from you.

phases.discover: I learn what problem the product solves, for whom and what goes into the first version.
phases.design: I sketch screens and flows and test them with you before writing code.
phases.build: I build in short deliveries you can try on your phone or in a preview.
phases.publish: I ship the app to the stores and the site to its domain, with analytics and backups.
phases.maintain: I fix, update and improve after launch, with an agreed plan.

hub.q1: Do you work remotely or do I need to be in Madrid?
hub.a1: I work remotely with clients across Spain and abroad. When needed, I can travel to one-off meetings in Madrid.
hub.a2: Yes. Every job is invoiced with VAT and a detailed invoice, and the payment method is agreed before starting.
hub.q3: Which languages can I write to you in?
hub.a3: Spanish and English. Code documentation and commit messages are in English.
hub.q4: How long do you take to reply?
hub.a4: I answer every enquiry within one or two working days, usually sooner. If it is urgent, say so in the message.

freelance.q1: Is there a minimum number of hours?
freelance.a1: There is no fixed minimum. For very small tasks we agree a block of hours or a per-task price before starting.
freelance.q2: Which suits me better, hourly or per task?
freelance.a2: Per task if the scope is clear and you want a fixed price. Hourly if the scope may change or is exploratory.
freelance.a3: I work in short deliveries you can try, and I share each step without waiting for the end.
freelance.q4: What happens if the scope grows?
freelance.a4: We agree it before going on: I explain what changes in time and cost, and you decide whether to include it or leave it for another task.

packs.q1: How much does a mobile app cost?
packs.a1: It depends on the pack and the extras. Each pack has a "from" price and, after talking to you, I give you a fixed quote with a delivery date.
packs.a2: Design, development and release. The exact list for each pack is in the comparison and is confirmed in writing before starting.
packs.q3: Is publishing to the stores included?
packs.a3: Yes. Packs with an app include publishing to the App Store and Google Play, and web packs include the domain and hosting.
packs.a4: It is optional and contracted separately, with a monthly plan agreed according to what your product needs.
packs.q5: What do I need to provide?
packs.a5: The texts, the images and the business decisions. I tell you what I need in each phase and when, so delivery is not held up.
